# SP — signal-publication role profile r0.5

Exact role: publication eligibility and decision for the atomic filtered
amplitude signal on 'V_signal'. It requires PA, SA, template admission, exact
operator/support/normalization, unit/calibration, operational response
identity, lifecycle, and provenance. Optional CU/NU/RU/FH not requested or
unavailable do not block SP unless an explicit named-use policy requires one.
